name: gait-and-velocity
title: Gait Quantified — Stride, Duty, Velocity
question:
What gait does the evolved walker produce — how regular is its stride, how is
stance/swing balanced, and how fast does the body move?
claim:
A regular gait: stride period 19.8 ± 0.4 steps (the spread is only ~2% of the
period), duty factor 0.44 (stance and swing nearly balanced), mean body
velocity ~9.0 units/time (~0.9 units/step).

expected_behavior.name: regular-stride-and-duty
expected_behavior.observable: stride period + duty factor + mean velocity
expected_behavior.rationale:
stride_period finite and regular (period std < half the mean), duty factor
in the walking band (0.2–0.7; achieved 0.44), positive mean velocity.
Computed by gait_metrics and pinned in tests/test_walker_seed.py.

findings.summary: Stride period 19.8 ± 0.4 steps, duty factor 0.44, mean velocity ~9.0 — a regular, balanced gait.
findings.detail:
